name: National Strategy for Data & AI (NSDAI, 2020)
owner: الهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي / Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA)
description: National Strategy for Data & AI (NSDAI, launched October 21, 2020 with 2030 horizon). National Strategy for Data & AI (NSDAI) of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia issued by the Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA), setting strategic targets through 2030 across six dimensions: Ambition, Skills, Policy & Regulations, Investment, Research & Innovation, and Ecosystem.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by الهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي / Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA) (sdaia.gov.sa) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for الهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي / Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA) (sdaia.gov.sa).
